approved.en: Russian forces continue striking Ukrainian targets, including a railway station where a drone attack killed 13 people and another station where 14 were killed. In the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky a localized cease-fire entered its third day while attacks on aid vehicles persist, prompting evacuations of residents toward Ukraine and Belarus. Evacuees from Oleshky have been arriving in Ukraine via Belarus and reuniting with families. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Russiske styrker fortsetter å slå mål i Ukraina, inkludert en jernbanestasjon hvor et droneangrep drepte 13 personer og en annen stasjon hvor 14 ble drept. I den russisk-okkuperte byen Oleshky har en lokalisert våpenhvile nå gått inn i sin tredje dag mens angrep på hjelpeskjøretøy vedvarer, noe som fører til evakueringer av innbyggere mot Ukraina og Hviterussland. Evakuerte fra Oleshky har ankommet Ukraina via Hviterussland og gjenforenes med familier. Konflikten forårsaket 75 767 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Israeli forces continue demolishing homes of Palestinians accused of attacks in the West Bank, while settlers attacked Palestinian olive harvesters, wounding three. In Gaza, at least four Palestinians were killed as Israeli attacks persisted and children faced deadly risks on their way to school. The UN rights office warned of a deepening displacement nightmare in Gaza and called for an urgent UN protection force to be deployed to Palestine. Rare footage of Mohammed Deif and previously unseen videos of Hamas commanders who have since been killed by Israel were released, adding new visual evidence to the conflict.

I Gaza ble minst fire palestinere drept mens israelske angrep vedvarte og barn møtte dødelige farer på vei til skolen. FN-s menneskerettighetskontor advarte om en dypere fordrivelsesmareritt i Gaza og oppfordret til at en hastig FN-beskyttelsesstyrke ble utplassert i Palestina. Sjeldne opptak av Mohammed Deif og tidligere usette videoer av Hamas-kommandanter som siden er drept av Israel ble publisert, og gir nye visuelle bevis på konflikten.

approved.en: Hezbollah continues to fire rockets and artillery at Israeli positions in southern Lebanon while Israel carries out air strikes on Hezbollah sites, causing civilian casualties. In northern Israel a Hezbollah submunition exploded in a teenager's backpack, killing Elazar Yair Wilensky and wounding dozens, prompting an IDF investigation. Lebanese olive harvests proceed under the threat of drones and warplanes, and UN peacekeepers are withdrawing from Lebanon after pressure from Israel. Qatar has pledged reconstruction funding and announced a large solar plant project for southern Lebanon. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I nordlige Israel eksploderte en Hezbollah-submunisjon i en tenårings ryggsekk, og drapet Elazar Yair Wilensky og såret dusinvis, noe som har utløst en etterforskning fra IDF. Libanons olivenhøst fortsetter under trussel fra droner og kampfly, og FN-fredsbevarere trekker seg tilbake fra Libanon etter press fra Israel. Qatar har lovet midler til gjenoppbygging og kunngjort et stort solkraftprosjekt for sørlige Libanon. UCDP registrerte 4 335 dødsfall i væpnede konflikter i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Iranian Revolutionary Guard forces report three tankers ablaze and mines hitting four tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, while Iran’s foreign minister welcomes US outreach during a Qatari mediation visit. Iran’s supreme leader orders the military to expand retaliation plans without geographic limits, and Iran’s security chief debates discarding the nuclear weapons ban. Iranian envoys meet Qatari mediators as the United States threatens strikes after the midterms, and Iran’s strikes on U.S. Middle East bases are found to have disabled early-warning systems. 123 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

Irans øverste leder beordrer militæret til å utvide gjengjeldelsesplanene uten geografiske begrensninger, og Irans sikkerhetssjef diskuterer å forkaste forbudet mot atomvåpen. Iranske sendebud møter qatarske meglere mens USA truer med angrep etter midtvalgene, og Irans angrep på amerikanske baser i Midtøsten viser seg å ha deaktivert tidligvarslingssystemene. 123 kamprelaterte dødsfall har skjedd i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Houthi forces have intensified cross-border strikes, launching drones toward Mecca that Saudi air defenses intercepted and targeting Saudi airports, including Aden where missiles hit the airport and presidential palace. In Yemen, fighting around Taiz and in Aden has displaced 290,000 people, including pregnant women, and Saudi air strikes have killed civilians in a residential area. The Houthis are also reported to be using Russian satellites to coordinate attacks. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: RSF forces have carried out drone strikes on a market in Darfur, killing over 100 civilians and damaging a power station that cut electricity to two states. The Sudanese army is accused of launching 162 drone attacks from Ethiopian territory, a claim Ethiopia denies. A senior RSF commander has defected from Hemedti's forces, accusing the group’s leadership of nepotism. An investigation has mapped RSF commanders linked to wartime rape. The UAE federal court sentenced eight people to life imprisonment for illegal arms supplies to Sudan’s army, and there were 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Den sudanske hæren blir anklaget for å ha gjennomført 162 dronavianser fra etiopisk territorium, en påstand Etiopia benekter. En høytstående RSF-kommandør har gått over til side fra Hemedti sine styrker og anklager gruppens ledelse for nepotisme. En etterforskning har kartlagt RSF-kommandører knyttet til krigs­voldtekt. Den føderale domstolen i De forente arabiske emirater dømte åtte personer til livsvarig fengsel for ulovlig våpensupplysning til den sudanske hæren, og det var 4 680 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

Sudan has accused Ethiopia of supplying the RSF with arms and of using Assosa Airport as a launch base for RSF drones. Two attacks four days apart in Oromia killed 60 Orthodox Christians. The conflict continues amid the Fano insurgency in Amhara, which began in 2023 over the government's security reforms. 2,824 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

Sudan har anklaget Etiopia for å forsyne RSF-militsen med våpen og for å bruke Assosa lufthavn som avfyringsbase for RSF-droner. approved.en: Al-Shabaab intensified assaults on Somali army positions in Lower Shabelle, killing a former al-Shabaab finance chief and raising the army toll, while Somali forces reported recapturing about 55% of territory previously held by al-Shabaab and ISIS. African Union troops are withdrawing from four bases in Lower Shabelle and Ethiopia is pulling more than 3,000 troops from Somalia, reducing external military presence. Somalia agreed to acquire Pakistani JF-17 fighter jets and the UAE carried out its first drone strike against al-Shabaab in nearly a year. Piracy off Somalia’s coast is rising with hijacked oil tankers and hostages reported. The conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Afrikanske unionens tropper trekker seg tilbake fra fire baser i Lower Shabelle, og Etiopia trekker mer enn 3 000 soldater fra Somalia, noe som reduserer den utenlandske militære tilstedeværelsen. Somalia har gått med på å anskaffe pakistanske JF‑17 jagerfly, og De forente arabiske emirater gjennomførte sitt første droneangrep mot Al-Shabaab på nesten ett år. Piratvirksomhet utenfor Somalias kyst øker, med kaprede oljetankskip og rapporterte gisler. Konflikten forårsaket 2 284 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: The United States has imposed sanctions on Rwanda's defence ministry for supplying the M23 rebels and operating a gold-smuggling route that funds an Islamic State-linked insurgency in eastern DRC. Former president Joseph Kabila has joined the conflict as the latest rebel leader, aligning himself with armed groups opposing the Congolese government. The sanctions target Rwanda's support for M23, which continues its campaign of offensives in the region. The conflict caused 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Den tidligere presidenten Joseph Kabila har blitt med i konflikten som den nyeste opprørslederen, og stiller seg på siden av væpnede grupper som motsetter seg den kongolanske regjeringen. Sanksjonene retter seg mot Rwandas støtte til M23, som fortsetter sin offensivkampanje i regionen. Konflikten forårsaket 1 158 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Cameroon has expanded its BIR rapid-intervention force around Lake Chad and is deploying drones and joint border patrols to target Anglophone separatists in the Northwest and Southwest, where attacks on government forces persist.
